grammar_tips.title: Using adjectives to describe art and music
grammar_tips.explanation: Use adjectives like beautiful, moving, creative, or powerful to describe works of art. Example: The painting is very beautiful.

explanation_translation.Hindi: कला और संगीत का वर्णन करने के लिए beautiful, moving, creative, powerful जैसे विशेषणों का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: The painting is very beautiful.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 芸術や音楽を説明するときは「beautiful」「moving」「creative」「powerful」などの形容詞を使います。例：The painting is very beautiful.

grammar_tips.title: Talking about preferences with 'like', 'love', 'enjoy'
grammar_tips.explanation: Use verbs like 'like', 'love', and 'enjoy' to express your opinion. Example: I enjoy listening to jazz music.

explanation_translation.Hindi: अपनी पसंद बताने के लिए 'like', 'love', और 'enjoy' का प्रयोग करें। उदाहरण: I enjoy listening to jazz music.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 自分の好みを表現するときは「like」「love」「enjoy」を使います。例：I enjoy listening to jazz music.

grammar_tips.title: Using 'because' and 'so' to explain opinions
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'because' to give reasons and 'so' to show results. Example: I like this book because the story is exciting. The concert was great, so I want to go again.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'because' का उपयोग कारण बताने के लिए करें और 'so' का उपयोग परिणाम दिखाने के लिए। उदाहरण: I like this book because the story is exciting. The concert was great, so I want to go again.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 理由を述べるときは「because」、結果を示すときは「so」を使います。例：I like this book because the story is exciting. The concert was great, so I want to go again.
